_rationale: Re-weighted from the school's own crest colours. The crimson already on the crest leads; navy drops to a supporting slate; gold is an accent only (rules, highlights, dark-field text) rather than a fill. Navy+gold as a pair was dropped as an over-used 'prestige institution' cliche, and a cool primary on a warm ground read muddy.

ink.role: deepest maroon — hero, dark sections, footer

slate.role: supporting navy — utility icons, date blocks, metadata

gold.role: accent — rules, small fills, text on dark fields

goldLight.role: accent tint — type and hairlines on dark fields

goldDark.role: accent darkened for small text on cream (5.2:1)

error.role: form validation and 'unverified' flags ONLY — never a brand colour

text.role: warm charcoal body text (16.4:1 on cream)

muted.role: warm muted secondary text (6.0:1 on cream)

display.note: soft serif with optical sizing — heritage without stuffiness

body.note: deliberately not Inter/Roboto, which read as template defaults

devanagari.note: serif so the Sanskrit motto shares a voice with the English display face

shadows.note: warm-tinted — a cool shadow on a warm ground reads grey and muddy

motion.note: scroll reveals, counters and hover lifts only — no parallax; all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

motif.arch: Arched media frames reference school architecture and let a missing photograph read as an intentional frame rather than a broken image.

_source_of_truth_note: Hex values are a designed system, not sampled from the original logo file. Re-check against the crest once a high-resolution or vector logo asset is supplied (see docs/content-checklist.md).
